limitations: All scores are provisional browser assessments using the supplied screenshots and runtime narrative; referenced JSON artifacts were not independently inspected or rerun.
Transition pairs demonstrate visual consistency at sampled moments, not complete animation continuity or absence of intermediate layout shifts.
The supplied runtime narrative carries forward several checks from earlier rounds; those checks are reported evidence, not fresh independent observations.
Screenshots ending mid-content are not treated as clipping failures where scrolling is reported; complete reachability was not independently driven.
No hard-gate failure is established by this evidence, but absence of a demonstrated failure does not certify every boundary.
Synthetic predictions, source descriptions and stress answers establish layout behavior only; their wording was not classified as a production-copy defect or evidence of predictive quality.
Reported zero axe violations and sampled contrast passes do not establish complete keyboard, screen-reader, target-size or raster-text accessibility.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, hardware Back timing, microphone, haptics, real payments and OS delivery remain unverified.
Offline Circles and sample Sky do not demonstrate production authentication or social-service behavior.
No repeated novice-use evidence was supplied, so exemplary outcome-based certification is unavailable.
A is the normalized mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the normalized mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall uses unrounded means before rounding.
topFixes: Make the under-13 restriction a dedicated, understandable state with an explicit correction path.
Distinguish forecast horizon from check-back date wherever both appear.
Add explicit Back to forecast navigation to free reasoning and preserve readable context beneath fixed headers.
Improve unfocused input affordances, birthday labels and explanations for disabled birth-detail actions.
Make long source entries easier to scan and quiet the mist behind dense evidence text.
Consolidate export and save notices, clarify retry actions and improve initial share-preview readability.
Capture direct browser proof for remaining focus, announcement, pressed-state and hit-area questions before claiming every screen and component reaches A≥9 and F≥9.
